Hexaped, Ally, 1 pool,
Tremere Antitribu Ally with 3 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.
Hexaped may give a link counter to any Methuselah as a +1 stealth (D)
action. Remove Hexaped from the game if that action succeeds. The
Tremere antitribu who recruited it gets +1 bleed and +1 stealth when
bleeding the Methuselah with that link counter.

Messages.Author: MrJ
Messages.Body:
KlaitalSG@gmail.com skrev:

> Also wondering whats Hexapeds ally type? I would assume a demon, but
> wanting to be sure.
>

Hexaped is simply an Ally.
There is no keyword before (or intstead of) the word "ally" on the
card, so neither "demon", "mortal", "werewolf", "animal", or any other
keyword-interacting card sees it as anything special.

/J
